title: Rotunda
html_source: The Rotunda Hospital was Dublin’s first maternity hospital. It was originally called the Dublin Lying-in Hospital. Attached to the hospital were several public function rooms including a large rotunda, after which the hospital was re-named. It was used for fund-raising events.
